sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH units_stats AS (
    SELECT
        sd.department_code,
        sd.department_name,
        AVG(sso.total_units) AS avg_total_units,
        VARIANCE(sso.total_units) AS variance_total_units,
        STDDEV(sso.total_units) AS stddev_total_units
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sso
      ON sso.offer_dept_code = sd.department_code
    WHERE sd.is_degree_granting = 'Y'
      AND sd.department_name <> 'Chemistry'
    GROUP BY
        sd.department_code,
        sd.department_name
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN sso.total_units > 0 THEN 1 END) > 0
),
top_subjects_2022 AS (
    SELECT
        department_code,
        department_name,
        subject_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            sso.offer_dept_code AS department_code,
            sso.offer_dept_name AS department_name,
            COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sso
        JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
          ON sd.department_code = sso.offer_dept_code
        WHERE sd.is_degree_granting = 'Y'
          AND sso.term_code IN (
              SELECT term_code
              FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
              WHERE academic_year = '2022'
          )
          AND NOT (
              sso.offer_dept_name = 'Political Science'
              AND sso.subject_id = '17'
          )
        GROUP BY
            sso.offer_dept_code,
            sso.offer_dept_name
    )
    WHERE rn <= 10
)
SELECT
    ...

SELECT
    ...,
    'UnitsStats' AS reason
FROM units_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT
    ...,
    'TopSubjects2022' AS reason
FROM top_subjects_2022;
